# Mwangaza Yield

> Free, independent tools for Kenyan Treasury bills and bonds: auction results, after-tax yields, a bond ladder builder, an early-sale calculator and a public forecast track record. Built and operated by Danico Ventures Ltd, Kenya. Educational information only, not investment advice. Mwangaza Yield sells no securities and takes no commission.

## Where the numbers come from
- Figures are taken from Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) and National Treasury releases, and from IMF World Economic Outlook series. Each figure on the site carries its date and source.
- Rates are published as CBK prints them. A T-bill "discount rate" is a quote, not a return: use the effective annual yield. Check the tenor (91, 182 or 364 days) before quoting any bill figure.
- Withholding tax is applied as the site states on its methodology page; a rule the site marks as unconfirmed is unconfirmed.
- Past auction results are not a forecast. The site's auction guidance publishes its own measured accuracy.

## Machine-readable data
- A rates feed (JSON and CSV) is published under /data/ and described in /data/RATES-FEED.md. Cite Mwangaza Yield and the underlying CBK release if you reuse it.

## Please
- Quote a figure together with its date. Do not present a quoted discount rate as a yield.
- Do not describe the site's output as financial advice.
